services_heading: Complete Heating and Plumbing Services Across Sunderland
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full system overhauls, we've got every heating and plumbing need covered.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repair
services.desc: Boiler won't fire? Losing pressure? We attend same day and carry parts on the van. Most faults fixed first visit.

services.title: Boiler Installation and Replacement
services.desc: New A-rated condensing boilers with 10-year warranties. We handle the lot—removal, pipework, commissioning, and safety checks.

services.title: Central Heating System Overhaul
services.desc: Radiators cold? System draining? We power-flush, bleed, and balance your heating to run efficiently and save you money.

services.title: Landlord Safety Inspections
services.desc: Annual gas and heating safety certificates for rental properties. Quick, thorough, and fully compliant with regulations.

services.title: Radiator and Valve Repairs
services.desc: Leaking radiators, stuck TRVs, and thermostatic valves fixed quickly. We replace or repair on site to minimise disruption.

services.title: Plumbing and Leak Detection
services.desc: Burst pipes, frozen pipes, and water leaks tracked down and fixed fast. We minimise water damage and restore peace of mind.

about_pullquote: We answer the phone because we run this business ourselves.
about_para_1: JMSully Heating and Plumbing has served Sunderland homeowners and landlords for over 15 years. We started because we were tired of waiting days for engineers and paying over the odds. Today, we've completed over 2,000 heating installations and repairs across the region, and we still treat every call-out with the same urgency and care.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up when we say we will, diagnosing faults honestly, and never pushing unnecessary work. We're Gas Safe Registered, fully insured, and we carry common parts on every van so most jobs finish first time. Sunderland families and buy-to-let landlords come back to us because we're reliable, fair-priced, and actually pick up the phone.
